resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (plane-wave DFT code)

access.notes: Any version supporting hybrid functionals (e.g., HSE06) is acceptable.

resources.notes: Used for all DFT calculations: geometry optimizations and electronic structure.

access.notes: Efficiency library of norm-conserving and ultrasoft pseudopotentials.

resources.name: Crystal structure of MAPbI3 (MAPI)

access.notes: Can be obtained from ICSD or Materials Project (tetragonal phase). The agent is expected to locate a publicly available structure.

resources.notes: Used to build the bulk and surface models.

resources.name: Composition of triple-cation perovskite triLHP

access.notes: The composition Cs0.05(FA0.83MA0.17)0.95Pb(I0.83Br0.17)3 is given; the agent constructs a supercell to approximate this composition.

resources.notes: No pre-made dataset; the agent builds the supercell from the given stoichiometry using a suitable model.

resources.name: Molecular structure of spiro-MeOTAD

access.notes: Can be obtained from PubChem (CID: 20053233) or literature.

resources.notes: Used for building the isolated molecule and the interfaces.

resources.name: Projection-operator diabatization (POD) method reference

access.notes: Kondov et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 2007, 111, 11970. The agent implements the POD analysis based on this method.

resources.notes: Not a code, but the methodological description required to implement the charge transfer analysis.
